# Phase Three — Thirty Final Improvements

> The third review turns sparks into a constellation; under the Awtsmoos, every refinement protects one coherent revelation.

1. Keep the new facade additive to the existing `/universal-api` export.
2. Export `createAwtsmoos` from the existing barrel so root exports inherit it automatically.
3. Avoid package.json changes unless tests prove subpath discovery requires one.
4. Keep all new source modules below 120 lines.
5. Split authority construction from facade methods.
6. Split pipeline metadata from execution code.
7. Keep explanation pure and side-effect free.
8. Freeze public namespace objects where practical.
9. Never expose private compiler executors through discovery.
10. Preserve existing semantic support-policy vocabulary.
11. Preserve exact artifact-channel IDs already in the core.
12. Derive defaults from existing factories rather than inventing parallel constants.
13. Treat the facade seed as a default, not an override of explicit definition seed.
14. Validate before planning/compiling unless existing Portal already guarantees an equivalent gate.
15. Return existing canonical diagnostic structures rather than inventing incompatible error schemas.
16. Keep world transaction state independent from semantic artifact compilation unless explicitly bridged.
17. Make expert namespace names semantically unambiguous.
18. Add a discoverable `pipeline` descriptor rather than dozens of top-level inspection methods.
19. Include examples for arbitrary unknown future kinds to prove noun neutrality.
20. Include a constrained architectural example to prove graph semantics.
21. Include a deferred operation example to prove capability honesty.
22. Test deterministic plan/hash behavior across repeated runs.
23. Test compile-channel subsets.
24. Test no executor side effects during `plan`/`explain`.
25. Test legacy direct factories remain callable with unchanged shapes.
26. Close inherited authored-semantics tests before claiming stability.
27. Inspect current deployment scripts immediately before release because shared production tooling may move.
28. Re-fetch origin after all local verification and before push.
29. Verify deployed content/version in a fresh browser, not only with curl.
30. Leave final `REMAINING_WORK.md` empty only after planned-vs-actual DELTA, GitHub SHA, deployment SHA, and public route all prove closure.
